mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Balance of Power zero crossing identifies a transfer in buyer-versus-seller control of the full auction range; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when BOP crosses strictly above zero; short when it crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: BOP normalizes the completed candle body by its own full high-low auction range. It is not a return sum, moving average, regression, multi-bar path, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour within-auction control zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.range: completed bar high minus low, strict positive
features.event: current finite nonzero BOP sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero BOP sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical unsmoothed BOP zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no smoothing, threshold, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Igor Livshin canonical Balance of Power convention
external_basis.selection_use: published formula and zero-centerline direction only; no smoothing, incidence, or outcomes
